IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: HELP CHILDREN DISCOVER AND DEVELOP THEIR FULL POTENTIAL.
IRS990.MissionDesc: PRESIDIO HILL SCHOOL IS A CO-ED K-8 INDEPENDENT, PROGRESSIVE SCHOOL. LEARNING IS COLLABORATIVE AND AN ACTIVE EXPERIENCE WITH AN EMPHASIS ON INQUIRY. STUDENTS ARE ENGAGED IN THEIR OWN LEARNING AND GUIDED BY AN EXPERT FACULTY THROUGH A CHALLENGING AND INTEGRATED ACADEMIC PROGRAM THAT INSPIRES CURIOSITY AND CRITICAL THINKING.
IRS990.Desc: OPERATION OF A CO-EDUCATIONAL INDEPENDENT SCHOOL COMMITTED TO MULTI- CULTURALISM AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF ITS STUDENTS INTO ACTIVE AND RESPONSIBLE PARTICIPANTS IN THE WORLD. THE SCHOOL SERVES APPROXIMATELY 210 TK-8TH GRADE STUDENTS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: PRESIDIO HILL OFFERS AFTER SCHOOL RECREATIONS FOR STUDENTS. INCLUDED IN SUCH, THE ATHLETICS PROGRAM OFFERS A VARIETY OF ATHLETIC OPPORTUNITIES FOR STUDENTS IN GRADES 6-8. THE SCHOOL ALSO OFFERS THREE CAMP WEEKS DURING THE YEAR FOR STUDENTS IN GRADES TK-5: SUMMER CAMP, FEBRUARY CAMP, AND SPRING CAMP.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SCHOOL'S ENDOWMENT CONSISTS OF FUNDS ESTABLISHED FOR A VARIETY OF PURPOSES.

THE SCHOOL IS A NON-PROFIT ENTITY EXEMPT FROM THE PAYMENT OF INCOME TAXES UNDER INTERNAL REVENUE CODE SECTION 501(C)(3) AND CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE SECTION 23701D. ACCORDINGLY, NO PROVISION HAS BEEN MADE FOR INCOME TAXES. THE SCHOOL IS SUBJECT TO INCOME TAX ON NET INCOME THAT IS DERIVED FROM BUSINESS ACTIVITIES THAT ARE UNRELATED TO THE EXEMPT PURPOSES. THE SCHOOL FILES AN EXEMPT SCHOOL RETURN AND APPLICABLE UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME TAX RETURN IN THE U.S. FEDERAL JURISDICTION AND WITH THE CALIFORNIA FRANCHISE TAX BOARD.

A NONDISCRIMINATORY POLICY STATEMENT IS INCLUDED IN THE APPLICATION, INFORMATION BROCHURE PACKET, FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE MATERIALS, AND SCHOOL'S WEBSITE (WWW.PRESIDIOHILL.ORG) IN THE ADMISSIONS SECTION.
DURING 2024, THE SCHOOL RECEIVED EMPLOYEE RETENTION CREDIT FUNDS FROM THE IRS.
ASSISTANCE TO INDIVIDUALS IS EXCLUSIVELY FOR SCHOLARSHIP REDUCTIONS IN TUITION AND FEES.
THE HEAD OF SCHOOL RECEIVES A HOUSING ALLOWANCE EACH YEAR THAT IS TAXED AT NORMAL APPLICABLE RATES.

THE BOARD'S EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE DETERMINES THE HEAD OF SCHOOL'S COMPENSATION USING COMPARATIVE DATA OF PEER SCHOOLS PROVIDED BY AN AGGREGATED REPORT FROM THE CALIFORNIA INDEPENDENT SCHOOL BUSINESS OFFICERS ASSOCIATION.

TaxExemptBondsIssuesGrp.PurposeDesc: REFINANCING DEBT RELATED TO PROPERTY DEVELOPMENT FOR FACILITIES

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 1A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: IN CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES, AND ON A CASE BY CASE BASIS ONLY, THE BOARD DELEGATES AUTHORITY TO THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE TO ACT ON THE BOARD'S BEHALF, BUT ONLY WITH PRIOR BOARD APPROVAL.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE 990 IS REVIEWED BY SELECT MEMBERS OF THE FINANCE COMMITTEE, AND IS MADE AVAILABLE FOR REVIEW BY ALL BOARD MEMBERS DURING A SECOND SCHEDULED BOARD MEETING. BOARD MEMBERS ARE GIVEN THE OPPORTUNITY TO ASK QUESTIONS OR COMMENT ON THE CONTENT OF THE FORM AND SUCH COMMENTS AND QUESTIONS ARE CAPTURED IN THE BOARD MINUTES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: MONITORING IS PERFORMED REGULARLY BY THE OFFICERS TO IDENTIFY POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST. BOARD MEMBERS, OFFICERS, EMPLOYEES ARE ALL COVERED BY THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY. THE BOARD OR DESIGNATED COMMITTEE REVIEWS ANY CONFLICTS PRESENTED BY INTERESTED PARTIES. THE CHAIRPERSON APPOINTS A DISINTERESTED PERSON OR COMMITTEE TO INVESTIGATE THE TRANSACTION IN QUESTION AND REPORT FINDINGS TO THE BOARD. ALTERNATIVES TO THE PROPOSED TRANSACTION ARE IDENTIFIED AND COMPARED TO THE PROPOSED TRANSACTION. THE BOARD VOTES ON THE MOST BENEFICIAL OPTION FOR THE ORGANIZATION. IF THE BOARD HAS REASON TO BELIEVE AN INTERESTED PERSON HAS FAILED TO DISCLOSE THE POTENTIAL CONFLICT, THE BOARD WILL INVESTIGATE FURTHER AND IF NECESSARY, TAKE APPROPRIATE DISCIPLINARY AND CORRECTIVE ACTION. IF THERE IS A PERSON WITH ACONFLICT THEY RECUSED FROM VOTING ON THE MATTER.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES NEGOTIATES THE EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT WITH THE BOARD CHAIR, HEAD OF SCHOOL, OR DIRECTOR OF FINANCE AND OPERATIONS. THEY BENCHMARK LEAD ADMINISTRATORS SALARIES TO THE 40TH PERCENTILE OF THOSE IN SIMILAR ROLES AT THEIR PEER SCHOOLS IN SAN FRANCISCO. IF A PERSON IS NEW TO THE LEAD ADMIN ROLE, THEY GENERALLY START THAT PERSON'S SALARY SLIGHTLY BELOW THE 25TH PERCENTILE AND THEY GENERALLY TRY TO INDEX THAT SALARY TO THAT 40TH PERCENTILE WITHIN A FEW YEARS. TO DO THIS, THEY USE ANONYMIZED DATA FOUND ON THE ANNUAL CAL-ISBOA SURVEY, WHICH GIVES A PERCENTILE RANGE FOR EACH POSITION. THIS PEER DATA IS COMPOSED OF SAN FRANCISCO TK-8 INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS. THE HEAD OF SCHOOL AND DIRECTOR OF FINANCE AND OPERATIONS WORK THROUGH EACH SALARY SEPARATELY, AND THEN ADJUST SALARIES RELATIVE TO THE GENERAL PERCENTAGE INCREASE AUTHORIZED BY THE BOARD AND THE ISBOA COMPENSATION DATA. THEY KEEP SOME NOTES BUT DO NOT DOCUMENT ALL CONVERSATIONS ABOUT THE SALARY INCREASES. THEY GO THROUGH THIS PROCESS ANNUALLY, AND THE HEAD OF SCHOOL'S SALARY IS NEGOTIATED SEPARATELY BY THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD. THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE IS PROVIDED THE CURRENT SALARY COMPENSATION DATA FROM THE CAL-ISBOA SURVEY. THE PROCESS DESCRIBED HERE WAS LAST COMPLETED IN 2024.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST.
